If your Thanksgiving tradition involves seeing how much dessert you can balance on one plate, this one's for you:)

One More Pie is a 3D stacker game prompted into existence using @tryplayground, our experimental platform that lets you build web games with a few simple text prompts!

My high score is up (Planetarycode159), let’s see if anyone can beat it, happy thanksgiving!

https://playground.google/g/ycShSF
